mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 60-degree temperatures and clear skies out at Badger Prairie County Park, with a first quarter moon currently visible.

The City of Verona is accepting applications for an Engineering Technician to oversee public construction projects until September 20. Additionally, the City has implemented a new rain barrel rebate program and recently adjusted sewer and stormwater utility rates to ensure our infrastructure remains self-supporting.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today, along with live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.

In a report from last Friday, August 15, officers responded to a call regarding a driver who was found unconscious behind the wheel near North Main Street and Cross Country Road, leading to an O W I arrest.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. Culver's is currently closed, but they will open their doors at 10 AM today.
